name: sozvon-server
description: Your own Sozvon server on Cloudflare: ask Claude or ChatGPT about your calls when the Mac is off

SOZVON_PASSWORD.description: Choose a long password. Sozvon on your Mac uses it to upload calls, and you type it once when you connect Claude or ChatGPT. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 24`.

DB.description: Your calls: transcripts, summaries, the search index, and (unless turned off in Sozvon) call audio and voice prints.

OAUTH_KV.description: Sign-in sessions of Claude and ChatGPT.
